req.title: Return JSON content type
req.statement: The system shall return application/json content type for all echo endpoints.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that all echo endpoints (/get, /post, /put, /patch, /delete) must return application/json content type. I design: (1) positive EP tests for each endpoint verifying exact Content-Type header value and HTTP 200 status; (2) a negative test verifying that a wrong method on an endpoint returns 405 (not 2xx with JSON); (3) boundary tests checking the exact string 'application/json' is present (not a superset/subset), and that the response body is valid JSON with expected top-level keys. Mutation resilience is achieved by asserting exact status codes (200 not >=200), exact content-type strings (startswith check + exact substring), and exact JSON key presence.

tests.name: test_get_returns_application_json_content_type
actions: Send GET request to /get via test client
Inspect response status and Content-Type header
expected: Response body is valid JSON with keys: url, args, headers, origin
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_returns_application_json_content_type():
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert 'url' in body
    assert 'args' in body
    assert 'headers' in body
    assert 'origin' in body
    assert 'form' not in body
    assert 'data' not in body

tests.name: test_post_returns_application_json_content_type

Inspect response status and Content-Type header
expected: Response body is valid JSON with keys: url, args, form, data, origin, headers, files, json
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_returns_application_json_content_type():
    r = client.post('/post', data='hello', content_type='text/plain')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    for key in ('url', 'args', 'form', 'data', 'origin', 'headers', 'files'):
        assert key in body
    assert ct.startswith('application/json')

tests.name: test_content_type_exact_value_not_text_html_or_text_plain
preconditions: All echo endpoints must return application/json
actions: Send requests to all five echo endpoints
Assert Content-Type is application/json and NOT text/html or text/plain
expected: Content-Type header starts with application/json for all endpoints
trace: boundary: exact media type string must be application/json
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_content_type_exact_value_not_text_html_or_text_plain():
    endpoints = [
        ('GET', '/get'),
        ('POST', '/post'),
        ('PUT', '/put'),
        ('PATCH', '/patch'),
        ('DELETE', '/delete'),
    ]
    for method, path in endpoints:
        r = client.open(path, method=method)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f"{method} {path} status={r.status_code}"
        ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
        assert 'application/json' in ct, f"{method} {path} ct={ct}"
        assert 'text/html' not in ct, f"{method} {path} ct={ct}"
        assert 'text/plain' not in ct, f"{method} {path} ct={ct}"

tests.name: test_get_with_query_params_still_returns_json
actions: Send GET /get?foo=bar&baz=1 via test client
Inspect Content-Type and body args field
expected: args field contains foo=bar and baz=1 exactly
trace: view_get returns args from query string
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_with_query_params_still_returns_json():
    r = client.get('/get?foo=bar&baz=1')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert body['args']['foo'] == 'bar'
    assert body['args']['baz'] == '1'
    assert 'url' in body
    assert 'headers' in body
    assert 'origin' in body

tests.name: test_post_json_body_echoed_with_json_content_type
actions: Send POST /post with Content-Type application/json and JSON body
Inspect response Content-Type and json field in body
expected: Response body json field equals posted JSON object exactly
trace: view_post echoes json field via get_dict
DT: JSON input -> JSON output content type
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json
client = app.test_client()

def test_post_json_body_echoed_with_json_content_type():
    payload = {"key": "value", "num": 42}
    r = client.post(
        '/post',
        data=json.dumps(payload),
        content_type='application/json'
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    assert ct.startswith('application/json')
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert body['json'] == {"key": "value", "num": 42}
    assert body['json']['num'] == 42
    assert body['json']['key'] == 'value'

tests.name: test_all_echo_endpoints_return_200_and_json_content_type_deterministic
preconditions: All five echo endpoints are registered
actions: Send correct HTTP method to each of the five echo endpoints
Assert status 200 and Content-Type application/json for each
expected: All five endpoints return exactly HTTP 200
All five endpoints return Content-Type starting with application/json
trace: view_get, view_post, view_put, view_patch, view_delete all use jsonify
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_all_echo_endpoints_return_200_and_json_content_type_deterministic():
    cases = [
        ('GET', '/get'),
        ('POST', '/post'),
        ('PUT', '/put'),
        ('PATCH', '/patch'),
        ('DELETE', '/delete'),
    ]
    for method, path in cases:
        r = client.open(path, method=method)
        assert r.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200 for {method} {path}, got {r.status_code}"
        ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
        assert ct.startswith('application/json'), f"Expected application/json for {method} {path}, got {ct!r}"

from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_delete_with_query_params_returns_json_with_args():

    assert r.status_code == 200
    ct = r.headers.get('Content-Type', '')
    assert 'application/json' in ct
    assert ct.startswith('application/json')
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert body['args'] == {'x': '1'}
    assert body['args']['x'] == '1'
